## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] New user-facing text is in both `en` and `zh-CN` (see docs/translations.md)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), agreeing to the licensing terms in CONTRIBUTING.md
